item.title: AI for Legal Contract Analysis 2026: Tools, Use Cases, and ROI
item.description: AI contract analysis in 2026 delivers measurable, documented ROI: the AI-in-legal market grows from $4.59 billion in 2025 to $5.59 billion in 2026, and is on a trajectory to reach $35.11 billion by 2030. A 100-page agreement that once required 6–8 attorney hours at $200–$500 per hour now takes AI 5–15 minutes at a cost of $10–$50 per review. That arithmetic is compelling enough that large law firms, corporate legal departments, and in-house counsel teams are moving from pilots to production deployments at scale.
